title.narrative: Integrated Humanitarian Support for IDPs and Vulnerable Populations through Housing Assistance in Aleppo and Lattakia Governorate

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn light of Syria’s protracted humanitarian crisis—characterized by prolonged displacement, depleted resources, and mounting pressure on underserved communities—this project aims to implement a targeted shelter intervention in Qadi Askar (Aleppo) and Qastal Maaf (Lattakia). Both areas have suffered extensive destruction in recent years and, as stability gradually returns, are now witnessing an increasing wave of internally displaced persons (IDPs) returning to rebuild their lives.ltbrgtThrough this project, the Syrian Development Organization (SDO) seeks to address critical housing gaps by rehabilitating 82 damaged apartments in Qadi Askar and another 82 in Qastal Maaf, thereby providing safer and more dignified living conditions for 164 displaced and vulnerable families. ltbrgtThe rehabilitation works will focus on essential shelter improvements, including: ltbrgt- Construction Works: Site Clearing, Concrete Works, and Internal Walls and Ceilings. ltbrgt- Finishing Works: Painting, Wood Works, Aluminum Works, Glass, Marbles, and Tiling. ltbrgt- Electrical Works: DB and Circuit Breakers, Cabling, Sockets and Switches, Lighting Devices, Electrical Devices. ltbrgt- Water-Sanitary Works.ltbrgtBy rehabilitating these essential housing units, the project not only enhances living conditions but also contributes to community stability and supports voluntary returns, enabling families to reintegrate in safer environments. ltbrgtThis intervention responds directly to the urgent needs identified in the target communities, aligning with the Sustainable Development Goals and reinforcing early recovery efforts. Built on strong partnerships with local stakeholders, it strengthens community resilience and lays the foundation for sustainable growth in areas long affected by conflict and neglect. ltbrgtOverall, the project reflects SDO’s commitment to delivering integrated, needs-based humanitarian responses in the shelter sector while offering a genuine opportunity to rebuild safer, more resilient communities.lt/pgt
